estimates.assumptions: 1 tbs olive oil = 14 g; pure fat, no carbs
2 medium red onions chopped ≈ 220 g total edible portion; standard onion carb values
1 red chilli finely chopped ≈ 20 g edible portion; standard fresh chilli values
1 garlic clove ≈ 3 g; standard garlic values
chopped coriander stalks (small bunch portion used here) ≈ 5 g; standard coriander values
800 g canned cherry tomatoes (whole can contents, drained weight not subtracted as sauce uses liquid); standard canned tomato values
1 tbs caster sugar ≈ 12 g; pure sugar
4 large eggs, raw, whole (edible portion only); standard egg values
feta sprinkling ≈ 20 g crumbled on top; standard feta values
